# SJ Landscapes

> Maidenhead's trusted landscaping and outdoor construction company. Building beautiful, functional outdoor spaces across Berkshire since day one.

## Core Expertise & Services
- Block Paving: Professional driveway installations, heavily compacted foundations, ensuring no sinkage.
- Patios: Expert installation of Porcelain and Indian Sandstone patio features.
- Landscape Design & Build: Full front and rear garden remodelling.
- Fencing & Gates: Security and aesthetic perimeter fencing including Trellis and Featheredge.
- Artificial & Real Lawns: Pet-safe artificial turf and high-grade real rolled turf.
- Pergolas & Summerhouses: Outdoor living spaces and custom timber construction.

## Working Region
Covering Maidenhead and the broader Berkshire area including:
- Windsor
- Marlow
- Wokingham
- Slough
- Henley
- Reading
